messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Spironolactone has not been shown to be safe and effective in children. The oral liquid is specifically not recommended for treating high blood pressure in children, because of the hormonal effects of the medicine. Any use in a child must be decided and monitored by a specialist.
Older adults:
Spironolactone is cleared by the kidneys, and kidney function tends to fall with age. Older adults are therefore more likely to build up a high potassium level, so kidney function and potassium need monitoring.
Triplet: ["spironolactone", "not safe or effective in", "children"]

The relation 'not safe or effective in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has not been proven to be safe or effective for use in the population or condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
B. 'has not been studied in': The subject drug has not been evaluated or tested in the patient population or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'does not reduce risk of': The subject drug does not lower the risk of the medical condition or event specified by the object entity.
D. 'not effectively removed by': The subject drug cannot be efficiently eliminated from the body using the method specified by the object entity.
E. 'does not demonstrate superiority': The subject drug does not show better effectiveness than the object drug in the specified clinical outcome.
F. None of the above.
